interpolation: Linearly interpolate only q[3:7] (hip,crank-minus-hip for left/right) using given reference weight, not a new controller/gain. Pure continuous-branch nominal kinematics.leg_configuration fills passive joints and existing drive mimics.
wheel_phase: Canonical public nominal-FK wheel_spin=0 for each wheel; no rolling-radius support shortcut. This fixed phase is explicitly an additional nominal geometry convention, not actual 4505 wheel spin or an all-spin-phase certificate.
oracle: One authoritative XML model normal boot with absolute compiler meshdir. No Plant/controller/DR construction. Thirty mj_forward calls at collision-free temporary rootZ=1m, qvel=0, ctrl=0. Each reported supported pose is exact rigid-Z translation of that same joint/pitch configuration; no extra pose sampling or second forward needed.
wheel_support: Use only the two compiled actual tire mesh vertex caches, each geom_xmat/geom_xpos applied exactly once. dz=-min(all tire world vertex z); supported rootZ=1+dz, and report each tire residual min-z+dz. Both gaps <=1e-8m is only numerical co-support consistency, not a physical operating bound. Mark unknown if inconsistent.
primitive_support: Verify compiled guide_wheel_05 is cylinder, compiled parent/offset/size/quaternion/axis. Exact min z = geom_center_z + dz - (radius*hypot(R20,R21) + half_length*abs(R22)); cylinder local axis is local Z. No rbound sphere.
clearance: Compare complete cylinder minimum-z with z=0.06m horizontal top plane; no finite-bar XY overlap assumed. Positive/negative is conditional vertical clearance, not collision occurrence if XY differs.
nominal_assumptions: supported main tire meshes only; no static force equilibrium inferred
source_scope: Only named small authoritative source/pose refs, no raw/heldout/H5/DR values/R56 code. Normal model boot may load existing mesh assets but no archival asset rehash or 279-mesh per-pose traversal. Only two tire caches and guide05 primitive evaluated.
